title: And Can It Be
lyrics:
Verse 1

And can it be that I should gain
An interest in the Savior's blood
Died He for me, who caused His pain
For me who Him to death pursued
Amazing love how can it be
That Thou my God should die for me

Chorus

Amazing love how can it be
That Thou, my God, should die for me

Verse 2

He left His Father's throne above
So free so infinite His grace
Emptied Himself of all but love
And bled for Adam's helpless race
'Tis mercy all, immense and free
For O my God it found out me

Verse 3

Long my imprisoned spirit lay
Fast bound in sin and nature's night
Thine eye diffused a quick'ning ray
I woke the dungeon flamed with light
My chains fell off my heart was free
I rose went forth and followed Thee

Verse 4

No condemnation now I dread
Jesus and all in Him is mine
Alive in Him my living Head
And clothed in righteousness divine
Bold I approach the eternal throne
And claim the crown through Christ my own

Chorus/Ending

Amazing love how can it be
That Thou, my God, should die for me
Oh rise my soul you’ve been set free
My life my all is Christ the King

title: Have You Been to Jesus
lyrics:
Verse 1

Have you been to Jesus, has your heart grown cold?
Friend have you forgotten, straying from the fold?
Remember how he loves you, that he came to die
How lowly He descended, that he might lift you high
Come and gaze at his Cross Oh how merciful!
Scan the depths of his love how unsearchable!
His affection for you so immovable!
Oh bring your heart to Jesus! Oh come and worship Jesus!

Verse 2

Have you been to Jesus? Hear him call your name
“Child my blood spoken” over all your shame
Are you trusting in him, for your every breath?
Have you known the healing, of his peace and rest?
Come and smile in the warmth of his brilliant love!
Have you tasted and seen oh how marvelous!
There is none to compare oh how glorious!
Oh, have you looked to Jesus? Oh, lift your eyes to Jesus!

Verse 3

Have you been to Jesus? Bring your sin torn soul
Come receive the comfort, from the one who knows
He is your defender, when you stand accused
Where sin has left you broken He can heal your wounds
He has conquered our sin He has paid our debt
Every charge Satan brings he has laid to rest!
We have nothing to fear let us come to him!
Oh bring your sin to Jesus! Oh come and worship Jesus
Have you laughed in surprise at his lavish gift
So determined his love oh how generous
How unsparing his grace that he gives and gives
Oh, who compares with Jesus? Oh, let us worship Jesus

Tag

Who compares, who compares
Who compares with Jesus

Ending

Come and gaze at his Cross Oh how merciful!
Scan the depths of his love how unsearchable
His affection for you so immovable!
Oh bring your heart to Jesus
Oh bring your heart to Jesus, Oh come and worship Jesus

title: I Give You All
lyrics:
Verse 1

Here at the cross I kneel in the dust broken undone
The feet of my savior pierced for my sin
The crown of my shame has been placed upon him
What can a sinner give to this King
When all I can offer is the guilt that I bring

Chorus

I sing to you O God and I fall down on my knees
I bring to you O God my humble offering
Lord I give you all of me

Verse 2

I give you all all that I have all that I am
I give you my worship I give you my love
I give you my life Lord my heart and my all
What can a servant give to his King
When all I can offer is what you’ve given me

Bridge

What can I offer you when all the best I do
Is filled with sin and pride
Lord hear my spirits cry
Though I am weak and poor and I have nothing more
Than this poor sinners praise
A song that must be raised

title: O For a Thousand Tongues to Sing
lyrics:
Verse 1

O for a thousand tongues to sing
My great Redeemer's praise
The glories of my God and King
The triumphs of His grace

Verse 2

My gracious Master and my God
Assist me to proclaim
To spread thru all the earth abroad
The honors of Thy name

Verse 3

Jesus the name that calms our fears
That bids our sorrows cease
'Tis music in the sinner's ears
'Tis life and health and peace

Verse 4

He breaks the pow'r of canceled sin
He sets the pris'ner free
His blood can make the foulest clean
His blood availed for me

Verse 5

Glory to God and praise and love
Be ever ever giv'n
By saints below and saints above
The Church in earth and heav'n

title: In You Is Mercy
lyrics:
Verse 1

In You is mercy grace to forgive
Where even the worst of sinners can live
Now through the cross you’ve washed away
The sin the shame the hurt the blame
All the wrath that we deserved was place on Christ
We will ever praise you for the death You died

Chorus

So great in love you gave Your only Son
That we could come before the throne of god

Verse 2

In you is power over the grave
Death is defeated sinners are raised
Now through the Spirit we have received
Your hope your power your grace your peace
All the righteousness of Christ was placed on us
Now you see us through the work that he has done

Bridge

Standing in wonder
In awe of your goodness
Standing in wonder
In awe of your goodness

title: Solid Rock
lyrics:
Verse 1

My hope is built on nothing less
Than Jesus’ blood and righteousness
I dare not trust the sweetest frame
But wholly trust in Jesus’ Name

Chorus

On Christ the solid Rock I stand
All other ground is sinking sand

Verse 2

His oath, His covenant, His blood
Support me in the whelming flood
When all around my soul gives way
He then is all my Hope and Stay

Verse 3

When He shall come with trumpet sound
Oh may I then in Him be found
Dressed in His righteousness alone
Faultless to stand before the throne

Bridge

On Christ, on Christ we will stand
On Christ, on Christ we will stand

title: Before My Knees Could Reach the Ground
lyrics:
Verse 1

How oh Lord could You forgive
A heart that’s cold and hard
I squandered all You gave to me
Lord have I gone too far

Chorus

Before my knees could reach the ground
Before my cry had made a sound
Before the words could pass my lips
You came quickly
In the moment I was caught
Before my mind could form the thought
Before my heart was taught to praise
It was your plan to show me grace
Oh how merciful you are
Oh how wonderful is your steadfast love

Verse 2

I thought in pride that I knew best
And wandered far from you
I woke ashamed a sinful mess
And there I longed for you

Bridge

Can I look to the one I have pierced?
Could it be my redemption is near?
Can I turn while my hand stills holds the spear?
Can it be my forgiveness is here?

Tag

You saw me from afar
You came running You came running!

title: Behold the Lamb
lyrics:
Verse 1

Jesus holy and anointed one
A voice cries out in the wilderness
Make way the Savior of the world
Oh the heavens above are opened up
The spirit descending as a Dove
The father’s He speak beloved Son
In whom I am pleased

Chorus

Behold the Lamb
Who takes away to sin of the world and stands
Mighty in His power to save
Behold the King
The Lion who has triumphed over the grave
Given the name above all names

Verse 2

Savior exalted over sin and death
The grave breaks before your righteousness
And now ascending in the clouds
Oh the heavens above are opened wide
The spirit descends in tongues of fire
Awakening hearts to know your love
Boldness to speak

Bridge

Awestruck in the moment speechless as he comes
Weeping or rejoicing all will see he’s Lord of Lords
Oh the heavens above are torn in two
In righteousness rides the Son of truth
Heaven and earth will bow down low
All will proclaim

title: The Sparrow
lyrics:
Verse 1

Oh child why do you worry
These fears they block your view
The Father full of mercy
He’s smiling over you

Chorus

His eye is on the Sparrow
His voice has calmed the sea
His heart it’s ever for you
He knows your every need

Verse 2

When storms and clouds surround you
The floods begin to rise
Remember Jesus found you
He’ll never leave your side

Verse 3

When your heart is darkened
And caged in by the night
Your soul the Spirit brightens
And sets your wings to flight

title: Flesh and Blood
lyrics:
Verse 1

Flesh and blood The Son of God has come
His glory set aside
In the dust Human just like us
Flesh and blood reaching out to touch
Our weaknesses to bear
In his hands holding every care
He felt the brokenness we feel but never broke
Every grief of ours he knows

Chorus

Who is like Him? Like our Savior?
Made low, the One Most High
Who is like Him, Like our Saviour?
The Life that lived to die Who can comprehend?

Verse 2

Flesh and Blood Broken on the cross
In death His glory hides
In the grave There his glory waits
Uncontainable, our Saviour is alive
Risen now to glorious light

Tag

Jesus, the Lamb for sinners slain now lifted to the highest place

title: The Armor
lyrics:
Verse 1

May my armor be the belt of your truth
That holds me to you in the battles to come
May my armor be your righteousness as
A breastplate put on by your mercy oh God
May my armor be the shoes for my feet
The readiness of your Gospel of peace

Chorus

That I may be found to stand and not turn back
That I may be found to stand until the end

Verse 2

May my armor be the shield of your faith
For the enemy comes with his arrows aflame
May my armor be the helmet of Grace
On my head it will rest your salvation my God
May my armor be the word that is drawn
The sword of the Spirit piercing the dark

Verse 3

May my armies be the prayers of the saints
Poured out in faith that rise to your throne
May my armies be the preachers who teach
The truth of your Word give them boldness to speak
May my armies be the fellowship of
The ones who hold fast when trials have come

Chorus 2

Let us be a church that stands and will not turn back
Let us be a church that stands until the end

Verse 4

May my armies be the great crowd of saints
Lining the way as we run in this race
May my armies be the angels of light
That stand by our side and assist in the fight
May my armies be the songs of the saved
That roar like a wave to break down the walls

title: We Three Kings
lyrics:
Verse 1

We three kings of Orient are
Bearing gifts we traverse afar
Field and fountain moor and mountain
Following yonder star

Verse 2

Born a King on Bethlehem's plain
Gold I bring to crown Him again
King forever ceasing never
Over us all to reign

Chorus

Star of wonder star of night
Star with royal beauty bright
Westward leading still proceeding
Guide us to Thy perfect light

Verse 3

Frankincense to offer have I
Incense owns a Deity nigh
Prayer and praising all men raising
Worshiping God most high

Verse 4

Myrrh is mine its bitter perfume
Breathes a life of gathering gloom
Sorrowing sighing bleeding dying
Sealed in the stone-cold tomb

Verse 5

Glorious now behold Him arise
King and God and sacrifice
Alleluia Alleluia
Heaven to earth replies

title: Behold Our God
writers: Jonathan Baird, Meghan Baird, Ryan Baird, Stephen Altrogge

title: Some Come Through Fire
lyrics:
Verse 1

Come laying your guilt at his feet
Kindness you’ll meet mercy receive
There’s no need to hide or pretend
His welcome extends to the neediest man

Chorus

Some come through fire and some come through flood
Some through the desert but all through His blood
Some come rejoicing and some come in shame
Some with thanksgiving but all by His grace

Verse 2

It matters not from where you have come
But what he has done by giving his son
He loves you is that not enough
So feelings aside come boldly through Christ

title: All Creatures of Our God and King
writers: Jonathan Baird, Ryan Baird (new music and arrangement)

title: Day After Day
lyrics:
Verse 1

Cast upon my savior’s cross are all my sins
And never will you choose Lord to remember them
Your cleansing blood has covered me and washed me clean
It will never fail

Chorus

Day after day you never change
Your power to save and strength to sustain
We praise yes we praise your name

Verse 2

Justified by what you’ve done at Calvary
Now living in the righteousness secured for me
For when you died and rose again you conquered death and
Defeated sin

title: House of the Lord
lyrics:
Verse 1

Jack started something big
When he showed his kids
The way they ought to live
He said money good and money fine
But it won't stand the test of time
Come on kids I'll show you where it's at
Follow me and I'll show you where it's at

Chorus

Going to the house of the Lord
Going to the house of the Lord
Going to the house of the Lord
To worship God

Verse 2

Lynn he just couldn't stay away
He said kids here's the dearest place
And here I'll be until I die because
I'm in love with Jesus Christ
Come on kids I'll show you where it's at
Follow me and I'll show you where it's at

Verse 3

Come here boy and I'll tell you a secret
From now on it will be your job to keep it
I'll pass the torch to keep it bright so
Spread the word and shine the light
Come on kids I'll show you where it's at
Follow me and I'll show you where it's at

Verse 4

Sons don't let the church lose a generation
Let that fire inside you grow with greater passion
Strike the note loud and clear
The joy you're looking for is here
Come on kids I'll show you where it's at
Follow me and I'll show you where it's at
